---
title: "Today's Skins"
# VERSION: 2026-10-21 (Mobile scoreboard: game cards, "I'm" picker, compact summary, collapsible history)
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        :root {
          --sk-surface: #2b2b2b; --sk-line: #444; --sk-muted: #aaa; --sk-accent: #f2a541;
          --sk-mine: #3a3121; --sk-good: #6fd497; --sk-good-bg: #173726; --sk-bad: #ff8a92; --sk-bad-bg: #3d1d21; --sk-bar: #444;
        }
        table { width: auto !important; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
        .sk-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 14px; font-size: 15px; margin: 0 0 6px 0; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.35); }
        .sk-btn { font-size: 13px; padding: 2px 10px; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.6); border-radius: 4px; }
        .sk-meta { font-size: 14px; color: #999; margin: 0; }
        .sk-who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 14px; color: var(--sk-muted); margin: 12px 0; }
        .sk-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
        .sk-seg button { font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
        .sk-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--sk-line); }
        .sk-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--sk-accent); color: #1b1b1b; font-weight: 600; }
        .sk-myday { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 16px 0; }
        .sk-myday > div { background: var(--sk-surface); border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; }
        .sk-myday .k { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--sk-muted); }
        .sk-myday .v { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .sk-h { font-size: 15px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--sk-muted); margin: 20px 0 8px 0; font-weight: 700; }
        .sk-games { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 330px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
        .sk-card { position: relative; background: var(--sk-surface); border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
        .sk-card .sk-stretch { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; border-radius: 10px; }
        .sk-card .sk-stretch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sk-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
        @media (hover: hover) { .sk-card:hover { border-color: #777; } .sk-card.mine:hover { border-color: var(--sk-accent); } }
        .sk-card.mine { background: var(--sk-mine); border-color: var(--sk-accent); }
        .sk-card .top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--sk-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .sk-card .top .status { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .sk-card .badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
        .sk-card .badge.zs { border: 1px solid var(--sk-accent); color: var(--sk-accent); }
        .sk-card .badge.upset { background: var(--sk-accent); color: #1b1b1b; }
        .sk-card .top .live { color: var(--sk-bad); font-weight: 600; }
        .sk-card .top .live::before { content: "\25CF  "; }
        .sk-card .top .final { color: inherit; font-weight: 600; }
        .sk-card .side { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr auto 42px 44px; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; }
        .sk-card .chg { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
        .sk-card .delta.up { color: var(--sk-good); }
        .sk-card .delta.down { color: var(--sk-bad); }
        .sk-card .abbr { font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; }
        .sk-card .owner { font-size: 15px; display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: baseline; min-width: 0; }
        .sk-card .owner .pick { font-size: 11px; color: var(--sk-muted); border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 4px; }
        .sk-card .side.me .owner { font-weight: 700; }
        .sk-card .side.won .name { background: var(--sk-good-bg); color: var(--sk-good); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 5px; }
        .sk-card .side.lost .abbr, .sk-card .side.lost .owner, .sk-card .side.lost .score { opacity: .55; }
        .sk-card .score { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }
        .sk-card .pct { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .sk-card .barrow, .sk-card .tug { position: relative; height: 8px; background: var(--sk-bar); border-radius: 3px; }
        .sk-card .barrow { grid-column: 2 / 4; }
        .sk-card .barrow .fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: var(--sk-muted); border-radius: 3px; }
        .sk-card .side.me .barrow .fill { background: var(--sk-accent); }
        .sk-card .side.won .barrow .fill { background: var(--sk-good); }
        .sk-card .gap { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; }
        .sk-card .gap.gain { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sk-good) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); }
        .sk-card .gap.loss { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sk-bad) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); }
        .sk-card .gap.swing { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); }
        .sk-card .tick { position: absolute; top: -4px; bottom: -4px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: #fff; border-radius: 1px; }
        .sk-card .tug { display: flex; height: 12px; margin: 2px 0 0 0; }
        .sk-card .tug .seg { height: 100%; background: #8a8a8a; }
        .sk-card .tug .seg + .seg { background: #555; }
        .sk-card .tug .seg:first-child { border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px; }
        .sk-card .tug .seg:nth-child(2) { border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; }
        .sk-card .tug .seg.me { background: var(--sk-accent); }
        .sk-card .tug .seg.won { background: var(--sk-good); }
        /* From the picked player's view: a skin that went to the other side is a loss, so show it red */
        .sk-card.mine .tug .seg.won:not(.me) { background: var(--sk-bad); }
        .sk-card .side.me.lost .owner { opacity: 1; }
        .sk-card .side.me.lost .name { background: var(--sk-bad-bg); color: var(--sk-bad); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 5px; }
        .sk-card .foot { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sk-muted); border-top: 1px solid var(--sk-line); padding-top: 6px; }
        .sk-tablewrap { overflow-x: auto; background: var(--sk-surface); border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 10px; }
        table.sk-table { width: 100% !important; margin: 0; border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 15px; }
        .sk-table th, .sk-table td { padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
        .sk-table th:first-child, .sk-table td:first-child { text-align: left; }
        .sk-table th { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--sk-muted); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sk-line); }
        .sk-table tr + tr td { border-top: 1px solid var(--sk-line); }
        .sk-table tr.me td { background: var(--sk-mine); font-weight: 700; }
        .sk-pill { border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 6px; }
        .sk-pill.pos { background: var(--sk-good-bg); color: var(--sk-good); }
        .sk-pill.neg { background: var(--sk-bad-bg); color: var(--sk-bad); }
        .sk-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sk-muted); margin: 6px 0 0 0; }
        details.sk-fold { background: var(--sk-surface); border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 10px; margin: 16px 0 0 0; }
        details.sk-fold > summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--sk-muted); }
        details.sk-fold[open] > summary { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sk-line); }
        details.sk-fold > .sk-inner { padding: 10px 12px; }
        details.sk-fold .sk-tablewrap { border: 0; }
        details.sk-fold img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
        .sk-dot { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); flex: none; }
        .sk-chart { background: var(--sk-surface); border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px 8px 12px; }
        details.sk-fold .sk-chart { border: 0; padding: 0; }
        .sk-ctabs { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .sk-cttl { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; }
        .sk-cdsc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sk-muted); margin: 0 0 6px 0; }
        .sk-cleg { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 14px; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
        .sk-cleg span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .sk-plot { position: relative; touch-action: pan-y; }
        .sk-plot svg { display: block; width: 100%; }
        .sk-plot svg text { fill: var(--sk-muted); font-size: 11px; }
        .sk-plot svg text.sk-end { fill: var(--bs-body-color, #fff); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
        .sk-tip { position: absolute; top: 0; pointer-events: none; background: #111; border: 1px solid var(--sk-line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; z-index: 2; }
        .sk-tip div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .sk-tip b { margin-left: auto; padding-left: 10px; }
        .sk-tip[hidden] { display: none; }
        .sk-empty { padding: 36px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--sk-muted); font-size: 14px; }
        @media (max-width: 768px) { table { font-size: 12px; } th, td { padding: 4px !important; } .sk-table th, .sk-table td { padding: 7px 6px !important; } table.sk-table { font-size: 14px; } #sk-today-summary th, #sk-today-summary td { padding: 7px 4px !important; } }
        </style>
    include-before-body:
      text: |
        <nav class='sk-nav'><a href='https://ejperez2.github.io/skins-standings/'>Standings</a><strong>Daily Matchups</strong><button id='refresh-btn' class='sk-btn' type='button' style='display:none;'>Refresh now</button><span id='refresh-msg' style='font-size:13px; opacity:0.85;'></span></nav>
        <script>
        // Refresh: asks the Cloudflare Worker (which holds the GitHub token) to start an update. No token needed here.
        (function () {
          var URL = "https://skins-refresh.ejperez2.workers.dev/?repo=Daily-Skins-Matchups";
          var btn = document.getElementById("refresh-btn"), msg = document.getElementById("refresh-msg");
          try { localStorage.removeItem("skinsRefreshToken"); } catch (e) {}  // token from the old owner-only button
          btn.style.display = "inline-block";
          btn.onclick = function () {
            btn.disabled = true; msg.textContent = "Starting...";
            fetch(URL, { method: "POST" })
              .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { msg: "Error " + r.status + "." }; }); })
              .then(function (d) { msg.textContent = d.msg || "Done."; })
              .catch(function () { msg.textContent = "Network error - try again."; })
              .then(function () { setTimeout(function () { btn.disabled = false; }, 30000); });
          };
        })();
        </script>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <footer style='font-size:14px; margin:28px 0 12px 0; padding:8px 16px 0 16px; border-top:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.35); opacity:0.85;'>Past seasons &middot; 2025-26: <a href='https://ejperez2.github.io/skins-standings/2025-26/'>Standings</a> &middot; <a href='https://ejperez2.github.io/Daily-Skins-Matchups/2025-26/'>Matchups</a></footer>
        <script>
        // "I'm" picker: highlight and pin the chosen player's games; remembered per browser.
        (function () {
          var KEY = "skinsMe";
          var me = "";
          try { me = localStorage.getItem(KEY) || ""; } catch (e) {}
          var seg = document.getElementById("sk-me");
          if (!seg) return;
          var originals = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll(".sk-games"), function (box) {
            return { box: box, cards: Array.prototype.slice.call(box.children) };
          });

          function tile(k, v) { return "<div><div class='k'>" + k + "</div><div class='v'>" + v + "</div></div>"; }
          function pill(x) {
            var n = parseFloat(x), cls = n > 0.1 ? "pos" : n < -0.1 ? "neg" : "";
            return "<span class='sk-pill " + cls + "'>" + (n > 0.05 ? "+" + x : Math.abs(n) < 0.05 ? "0.0" : x) + "</span>";
          }

          function apply() {
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(seg.querySelectorAll("button"), function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.getAttribute("data-me") === me)); });
            originals.forEach(function (o) {
              var mine = [], rest = [];
              o.cards.forEach(function (c) {
                var isMine = me !== "" && (" " + c.getAttribute("data-players") + " ").indexOf(" " + me + " ") >= 0;
                c.classList.toggle("mine", isMine);
                Array.prototype.forEach.call(c.querySelectorAll(".side, .tug .seg"), function (s) { s.classList.toggle("me", me !== "" && s.getAttribute("data-player") === me); });
                (isMine ? mine : rest).push(c);
              });
              mine.concat(rest).forEach(function (c) { o.box.appendChild(c); });
            });
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".sk-table tr[data-player]"), function (r) { r.classList.toggle("me", r.getAttribute("data-player") === me); });

            var strip = document.getElementById("sk-myday");
            if (!strip) return;
            if (!me) { strip.hidden = true; return; }
            strip.hidden = false;
            var row = document.querySelector("#sk-today-summary tr[data-player='" + me + "']");
            if (!row) { strip.innerHTML = tile("My games", "0") + tile("Expected skins", "&ndash;") + tile("Luck", "&ndash;"); return; }
            var states = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll("#sk-today-games .sk-card.mine"), function (c) { return c.getAttribute("data-state"); });
            var allPre = states.length && states.every(function (s) { return s === "upcoming"; });
            var allFinal = states.length && states.every(function (s) { return s === "final"; });
            var d = row.dataset;
            strip.innerHTML = tile("My games", d.games) +
              (allPre ? tile("Expected skins", d.exp) : allFinal ? tile("Skins won", d.won) : tile("Live expected", d.live)) +
              tile("Luck", allPre ? "&ndash;" : pill(d.luck));
          }

          // Remember which collapsible sections are open
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("details.sk-fold[id]"), function (d) {
            try { var v = localStorage.getItem("skinsFold:" + d.id); if (v !== null) d.open = v === "1"; } catch (e) {}
            d.addEventListener("toggle", function () { try { localStorage.setItem("skinsFold:" + d.id, d.open ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {} });
          });

          seg.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            var b = e.target.closest("button");
            if (!b) return;
            me = b.getAttribute("data-me");
            try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, me); } catch (err) {}
            apply();
          });
          apply();

          // While a game is live, reload every 5 minutes so the scoreboard stays current.
          if (document.querySelector("#sk-today-games .sk-card[data-state='live']")) {
            setInterval(function () { if (document.visibilityState === "visible") location.reload(); }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
          }
        })();
        // Season charts: hover or tap for each day's values (same style as the Standings page)
        (function () {
          var el = document.getElementById("sk-chart-data"), plot = document.getElementById("sk-plot");
          if (!el || !plot) return;
          var D = JSON.parse(el.textContent), PLAYERS = D.players, COLORS = D.colors, H = D.hist;
          var tabs = document.getElementById("sk-ctabs");
          function esc(x) { return String(x).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (ch) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[ch]; }); }
          function dot(p) { return '<span class="sk-dot" style="--c:' + COLORS[p] + '"></span>'; }
          var f1 = function (v) { return v.toFixed(1); };
          var CH = {
            luck: { ttl: "Cumulative skins luck", dsc: "Skins won minus expected skins. Above zero means luckier than the odds said.",
              key: "luck", zero: true, fmt: function (v) { return (v > 0.05 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(1); } },
            exp: { ttl: "Expected skins", dsc: "Running total of pregame expected skins.", key: "exp", fmt: f1 },
            won: { ttl: "Skins won", dsc: "Running total of skins won.", key: "won", fmt: function (v) { return v.toFixed(0); }, tip: function (v) { return v.toFixed(0); } }
          };
          var state = "luck";

          function niceTicks(a, b) {
            if (a === b) { a -= 1; b += 1; }
            var step0 = (b - a) / 4, mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)));
            var step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(function (m) { return m * mag; }).filter(function (s) { return s >= step0; })[0];
            var t = []; for (var v = Math.floor(a / step) * step; v <= b + step * 1e-6; v += step) t.push(+v.toFixed(6));
            if (t[t.length - 1] < b) t.push(+(t[t.length - 1] + step).toFixed(6));
            return t;
          }

          function draw() {
            if (!plot.clientWidth) return;  // inside a closed section; drawn when opened
            var c = CH[state], me = "";
            try { me = localStorage.getItem("skinsMe") || ""; } catch (e) {}
            tabs.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.getAttribute("data-c") === state)); });
            document.getElementById("sk-cttl").textContent = c.ttl;
            document.getElementById("sk-cdsc").textContent = c.dsc;
            document.getElementById("sk-cleg").innerHTML = PLAYERS.map(function (p) { return "<span>" + dot(p) + esc(p) + "</span>"; }).join("");
            if (H.length < 2) { plot.innerHTML = '<div class="sk-empty">Starts once the first games go final.</div>'; return; }

            var series = PLAYERS.map(function (p) { return { p: p, v: H.map(function (h) { var r = h.r[p]; return r ? r[c.key] : null; }) }; });
            var vals = []; series.forEach(function (s) { s.v.forEach(function (v) { if (v != null) vals.push(v); }); });
            var W = Math.max(280, plot.clientWidth), Hh = Math.round(Math.min(320, Math.max(220, W * 0.58)));
            var m = { l: 44, r: 76, t: 10, b: 24 };
            var y0 = Math.min.apply(null, vals), y1 = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
            if (c.zero) { y0 = Math.min(y0, 0); y1 = Math.max(y1, 0); }
            var yt = niceTicks(y0, y1); y0 = Math.min(y0, yt[0]); y1 = Math.max(y1, yt[yt.length - 1]);
            var n = H.length;
            var t = H.map(function (h) { return new Date(h.d + "T12:00:00").getTime(); }), t0 = t[0], t1 = t[n - 1];
            var xs = function (i) { return m.l + (t1 === t0 ? 0.5 : (t[i] - t0) / (t1 - t0)) * (W - m.l - m.r); };
            var ys = function (v) { return m.t + (1 - (v - y0) / ((y1 - y0) || 1)) * (Hh - m.t - m.b); };
            var fmtD = function (d) { return new Date(d + "T12:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric" }); };
            var xIdx = n <= 4 ? H.map(function (_, i) { return i; }) : [0, Math.round((n - 1) / 3), Math.round(2 * (n - 1) / 3), n - 1];
            var line = function (arr) {
              var d = "", on = false;
              arr.forEach(function (v, i) { if (v == null) { on = false; return; } d += (on ? "L" : "M") + xs(i).toFixed(1) + " " + ys(v).toFixed(1); on = true; });
              return d;
            };
            var svg = '<svg width="' + W + '" height="' + Hh + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + " " + Hh + '" role="img" aria-label="' + esc(c.ttl) + ' chart">';
            yt.forEach(function (v) {
              var z = c.zero && v === 0;
              svg += '<line x1="' + m.l + '" x2="' + (W - m.r) + '" y1="' + ys(v) + '" y2="' + ys(v) + '" stroke="' + (z ? "#888" : "#3a3a3a") + '" stroke-width="1"/>' +
                '<text x="' + (m.l - 6) + '" y="' + (ys(v) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + c.fmt(v) + "</text>";
            });
            xIdx.forEach(function (i) {
              svg += '<text x="' + xs(i) + '" y="' + (Hh - 6) + '" text-anchor="' + (i === 0 ? "start" : i === n - 1 ? "end" : "middle") + '">' + fmtD(H[i].d) + "</text>";
            });
            series.forEach(function (s) {
              svg += '<path d="' + line(s.v) + '" fill="none" stroke="' + COLORS[s.p] + '" stroke-width="' + (s.p === me ? 3 : 2) + '" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
            });
            var ends = [];
            series.forEach(function (s) { var last = -1; s.v.forEach(function (v, i) { if (v != null) last = i; }); if (last >= 0) ends.push({ s: s, i: last, y: ys(s.v[last]) }); });
            ends.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
            for (var k = 1; k < ends.length; k++) if (ends[k].y - ends[k - 1].y < 15) ends[k].y = ends[k - 1].y + 15;
            ends.forEach(function (e) {
              svg += '<circle cx="' + xs(e.i) + '" cy="' + ys(e.s.v[e.i]) + '" r="4" fill="' + COLORS[e.s.p] + '" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="2"/>' +
                '<text class="sk-end" x="' + (xs(e.i) + 8) + '" y="' + (e.y + 4) + '">' + esc(e.s.p.slice(0, 3)) + " " + c.fmt(e.s.v[e.i]) + "</text>";
            });
            svg += '<line class="sk-xh" y1="' + m.t + '" y2="' + (Hh - m.b) + '" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" visibility="hidden"/>' +
              '<rect class="sk-hit" x="' + m.l + '" y="0" width="' + (W - m.l - m.r) + '" height="' + Hh + '" fill="transparent"/></svg>';
            plot.innerHTML = svg + '<div class="sk-tip" hidden></div>';

            var hit = plot.querySelector(".sk-hit"), xh = plot.querySelector(".sk-xh"), tip = plot.querySelector(".sk-tip");
            var show = function (e) {
              var x = e.clientX - plot.getBoundingClientRect().left, best = 0;
              for (var i = 1; i < n; i++) if (Math.abs(xs(i) - x) < Math.abs(xs(best) - x)) best = i;
              var rows = series.map(function (s) { return { p: s.p, v: s.v[best] }; }).filter(function (r) { return r.v != null; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.v - a.v; });
              xh.setAttribute("x1", xs(best)); xh.setAttribute("x2", xs(best)); xh.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
              var tf = c.tip || c.fmt;
              tip.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--sk-muted)">' + fmtD(H[best].d) + "</div>" +
                rows.map(function (r) { return "<div>" + dot(r.p) + esc(r.p) + "<b>" + tf(r.v) + "</b></div>"; }).join("");
              tip.hidden = false;
              var tw = tip.offsetWidth;
              tip.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - tw, xs(best) + (xs(best) > W / 2 ? -tw - 10 : 10))) + "px";
            };
            hit.addEventListener("pointermove", show);
            hit.addEventListener("pointerdown", show);
            hit.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () { tip.hidden = true; xh.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"); });
          }

          tabs.addEventListener("click", function (e) { var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (b) { state = b.getAttribute("data-c"); draw(); } });
          var fold = document.getElementById("fold-season");
          if (fold) fold.addEventListener("toggle", draw);
          document.getElementById("sk-me").addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(draw, 0); });
          var rz; window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(rz); rz = setTimeout(draw, 120); });
          draw();
        })();
        </script>
    theme: darkly
    grid:
      body-width: 1200px
---

```{r expected_skins_data}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# This chunk must run first (invisibly) to create 'todays_picks'
# for the results tables that now appear at the top.

# --- Part 0: Define Time and Data Source ---

# Get current time in Chicago
current_time_ct <- now(tzone = "America/Chicago")
current_hour_ct <- hour(current_time_ct)

# Define the "skins date" based on the 2 AM cutoff.
# A "day" runs from 2:00 AM to 1:59 AM the next morning.
if (current_hour_ct < 2) {
  # If it's 1 AM, it's still "yesterday's" skins date
  skins_date <- as_date(current_time_ct) - days(1)
} else {
  # If it's 2 AM or later, it's "today's" skins date
  skins_date <- as_date(current_time_ct)
}

# Use skins_date as the definitive date for this run
today_ct <- skins_date 
current_year <- year(today_ct)

# Define blackout window: 11 PM (23:00) to 1:59 AM
use_csv_for_sportsline <- current_hour_ct >= 23 | current_hour_ct < 2

# League configuration (2026-27: 3 players x 10 teams each)
PLAYERS <- c("Eristeo", "Brian", "Adam")
TEAMS_PER_PLAYER <- 30 / length(PLAYERS)
SEASON_LABEL <- "2026-27"
SEASON_START <- as_date("2026-10-20")  # Opening night; YTD stats count from here

# Define draft_data (needs to be available for both branches)
# DRAFTED: Sunday, October 18, 2026 (10-round snake; order Adam, Brian, Eristeo).
# Teams with no player/pick are ignored.
draft_data <- tribble(
  ~Team, ~Matchup_Key, ~abbr, ~skins_pick, ~player,
  "Atlanta Hawks",          "Hawks|Atlanta",          "ATL", "W", "Brian",
  "Boston Celtics",         "Celtics|Boston",         "BOS", "W", "Adam",
  "Brooklyn Nets",          "Nets|Brooklyn",          "BKN", "L", "Eristeo",
  "Charlotte Hornets",      "Hornets|Charlotte",      "CHA", "L", "Eristeo",
  "Chicago Bulls",          "Bulls|Chicago",          "CHI", "L", "Eristeo",
  "Cleveland Cavaliers",    "Cavaliers|Cleveland",    "CLE", "W", "Eristeo",
  "Dallas Mavericks",       "Mavericks|Dallas",       "DAL", "L", "Brian",
  "Denver Nuggets",         "Nuggets|Denver",         "DEN", "W", "Adam",
  "Detroit Pistons",        "Pistons|Detroit",        "DET", "W", "Eristeo",
  "Golden State Warriors",  "Warriors|Golden State",  "GSW", "L", "Brian",
  "Houston Rockets",        "Rockets|Houston",        "HOU", "W", "Adam",
  "Indiana Pacers",         "Pacers|Indiana",         "IND", "W", "Brian",
  "Los Angeles Clippers",   "Clippers|LA Clippers",   "LAC", "L", "Brian",
  "Los Angeles Lakers",     "Lakers|LA Lakers",       "LAL", "W", "Eristeo",
  "Memphis Grizzlies",      "Grizzlies|Memphis",      "MEM", "L", "Eristeo",
  "Miami Heat",             "Heat|Miami",             "MIA", "W", "Adam",
  "Milwaukee Bucks",        "Bucks|Milwaukee",        "MIL", "L", "Brian",
  "Minnesota Timberwolves", "Timberwolves|Minnesota", "MIN", "W", "Adam",
  "New Orleans Pelicans",   "Pelicans|New Orleans",   "NOP", "L", "Eristeo",
  "New York Knicks",        "Knicks|New York",        "NYK", "W", "Brian",
  "Oklahoma City Thunder",  "Thunder|Oklahoma",       "OKC", "W", "Adam",
  "Orlando Magic",          "Magic|Orlando",          "ORL", "L", "Brian",
  "Philadelphia 76ers",     "76ers|Philadelphia",     "PHI", "W", "Adam",
  "Phoenix Suns",           "Suns|Phoenix",           "PHX", "L", "Adam",
  "Portland Trail Blazers", "Trail Blazers|Portland", "POR", "L", "Adam",
  "Sacramento Kings",       "Kings|Sacramento",       "SAC", "L", "Eristeo",
  "San Antonio Spurs",      "Spurs|San Antonio",      "SAS", "W", "Brian",
  "Toronto Raptors",        "Raptors|Toronto",        "TOR", "W", "Adam",
  "Utah Jazz",              "Jazz|Utah",              "UTA", "L", "Eristeo",
  "Washington Wizards",     "Wizards|Washington",     "WAS", "L", "Brian"
)

unknown_players <- setdiff(na.omit(draft_data$player), PLAYERS)
if (length(unknown_players) > 0) {
  stop("draft_data has players not in PLAYERS: ", paste(unknown_players, collapse = ", "))
}
# Only drafted teams count for skins
drafted_teams <- draft_data %>% filter(!is.na(player), skins_pick %in% c("W", "L"))

# --- Part 1: Get Data (Conditional) ---
if (use_csv_for_sportsline) {
  file_path <- file.path(history_dir, paste0(skins_date, ".csv"))
  
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    csv_data <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    if ("game_id" %in% colnames(csv_data)) {
      todays_picks <- csv_data %>%
        mutate(
          "Expected Skins" = Expected_Skins,
          Moneyline = NA_real_,
          "Implied Prob" = NA_real_,
          Live_Expected_Skins = NA_real_,
          game_time_ct = as.POSIXct(NA)
        ) %>%
        select(Date, Team, Pick, "Expected Skins", Player, Moneyline, "Implied Prob", Abbr, game_id, Won_Game, Actual_Skins, Skins_Luck, Live_Expected_Skins, game_time_ct) %>%
        arrange(desc(`Expected Skins`))
        
    } else {
      use_csv_for_sportsline <- FALSE
    }
    
  } else {
    use_csv_for_sportsline <- FALSE
  }
}

if (!use_csv_for_sportsline) {
  # --- Part 1.1: Scrape Expected Odds ---
  url <- paste0("https://www.sportsline.com/nba/odds/money-line/",
                "?t=", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M%S"))
  googlebot_ua <- "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1; +http://www.google.com/bot.html"
  page_session <- rvest::session(url, httr::user_agent(googlebot_ua))
  html_content <- rvest::read_html(page_session)
  game_data_raw <- html_content %>% html_element("table") %>% html_table()
  
  # Extract correct columns and clean team names
  game_data <- data.frame(
    Matchup_raw = game_data_raw[[1]],
    # Look up by header: SportsLine adds/moves columns (e.g. "Proj Score")
    consensus = game_data_raw[[which(tolower(names(game_data_raw)) == "consensus")[1]]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Remove the record (e.g., "2-1") from team names
      Matchup = str_remove(Matchup_raw, "\\d+-\\d+$")
    )

  # --- Part 1.2: Calculate Expected Skins ---
  convert_odds_to_prob <- function(odds) {
    prob <- case_when(
      odds < 0 ~ abs(odds) / (abs(odds) + 100),
      odds > 0 ~ 100 / (odds + 100),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
    return(prob)
  }
  
  # FIXED: Use word boundaries to prevent "Hornets" from matching "Nets"
  match_team <- function(matchup_str, draft_data) {
    matchup_upper <- str_to_upper(matchup_str)
    for (i in 1:nrow(draft_data)) {
      keys <- str_split(draft_data$Matchup_Key[i], "\\|")[[1]]
      keys_upper <- str_to_upper(keys)
      
      # Check if any of the keys match (with word boundaries)
      for (key in keys_upper) {
        pattern <- paste0("\\b", key, "\\b")
        if (str_detect(matchup_upper, regex(pattern))) {
          return(draft_data$Matchup_Key[i])
        }
      }
    }
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Parse based on actual structure
  todays_picks <- game_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Matchup) & Matchup != "") %>%
    mutate(
      row_id = row_number(),
      # Day header rows ("Today, Oct 20", "Thursday, Oct 22") come BEFORE their games
      game_day_str = str_match(Matchup_raw,
        "^\\s*[A-Za-z]+,\\s+((?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)\\s+\\d{1,2})\\s*$")[, 2],
      # Tip-off rows ("Advanced Insights 7:00PM ET on NBC") come AFTER their two team rows
      game_time_str = str_extract(Matchup_raw, "\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}\\s*[AP]M(?=\\s*ET)")
    ) %>%
    fill(game_day_str, .direction = "down") %>%
    fill(game_time_str, .direction = "up") %>%
    # Filter out the "Expert Picks" and "Advanced Insights" rows
    filter(!str_detect(Matchup, "Expert Picks|Advanced Insights")) %>%
    # Only keep rows with actual odds (contains +/- numbers)
    filter(str_detect(consensus, "[+-]\\d+")) %>%
    mutate(
      Matchup_Key = vapply(Matchup, match_team, draft_data = draft_data, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
      game_time_et = parse_date_time(
        paste(game_day_str, current_year, game_time_str),
        orders = c("b d Y I:M p"),
        tz = "America/New_York"
      ),
      game_time_ct = with_tz(game_time_et, tzone = "America/Chicago"),
      game_date_ct = as_date(game_time_ct),
      # Create game_id: every 2 consecutive rows are a game
      game_id = paste0(game_date_ct, "_", ceiling(row_number() / 2))
    ) %>%
    # *** THIS IS THE KEY FILTER ***
    # It now filters for games matching the "skins_date" (which is today_ct)
    filter(game_date_ct == today_ct, !is.na(Matchup_Key)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract odds from format like "-175Open: -189"
      moneyline = as.numeric(str_extract(consensus, "^[+-]?\\d+")),
      opening_odds = as.numeric(str_extract(consensus, "(?<=Open: )[+-]?\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    # Remove duplicates - keep one row per team per game
    distinct(Matchup_Key, game_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(implied_prob = convert_odds_to_prob(moneyline)) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      total_prob_in_game = sum(implied_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
      prob_no_vig = implied_prob / total_prob_in_game
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(drafted_teams, by = "Matchup_Key") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Team)) %>%
    mutate(
      expected_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", prob_no_vig, 1 - prob_no_vig),
      Date = today_ct,
      Won_Game = NA,
      Actual_Skins = NA_real_,
      Skins_Luck = NA_real_,
      Live_Expected_Skins = NA_real_
    ) %>%
    select(Date, Team, Pick = skins_pick, "Expected Skins" = expected_skins,
           Player = player, Moneyline = moneyline, "Implied Prob" = prob_no_vig,
           Abbr = abbr, game_id, Won_Game, Actual_Skins, Skins_Luck, Live_Expected_Skins, game_time_ct) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Expected Skins`))
}

# --- Part 2: Handle Draft Data Mismatch ---
# (This runs for both CSV and Scrape methods)
if (nrow(todays_picks) > 0) {
  teams_in_picks <- unique(todays_picks$Team)
  teams_in_draft <- unique(draft_data$Team)
  
  # Teams that are in picks but not in draft (indicates a mismatch in draft_data)
  unmatched_teams_in_picks <- setdiff(teams_in_picks, teams_in_draft)
  if (length(unmatched_teams_in_picks) > 0) {
    cat("WARNING: Teams in scraped data but not in draft_data:", 
        paste(unmatched_teams_in_picks, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r scrape_live_data}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# This chunk scrapes live win probabilities from gambletron
# and joins them with our 'todays_picks' data.


# Always scrape live data regardless of blackout window
# --- Define URLs ---
url_live <- "https://www.gambletron2000.com/live?sport=nba&team="
url_inactive <- "https://www.gambletron2000.com/inactive?sport=nba&s=start_time&team="

# --- 1. Scrape "Live!" Games ---
tryCatch({
  response_live <- GET(url_live, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"))
  webpage_live <- read_html(response_live)
  
  live_nodes <- webpage_live %>% html_elements("li.event-summary")
  
  live_games <- live_nodes %>%
    lapply(function(node) {
      # ENHANCED: More robust extraction with error handling
      teams_text <- tryCatch({
        node %>% 
          html_element("span.team") %>% 
          html_text2() %>% 
          trimws()
      }, error = function(e) NA_character_)
      
      teams <- if (!is.na(teams_text)) strsplit(teams_text, "\n")[[1]] else c(NA, NA)
      
      # CRITICAL FIX: Extract probabilities more carefully
      prob_elements <- node %>% html_elements("span.pull-right")
      probs <- if (length(prob_elements) >= 2) {
        prob_elements %>% 
          html_text() %>% 
          trimws() %>%
          head(2)  # Take only first 2 probabilities
      } else {
        c(NA_character_, NA_character_)
      }
      
      data.frame(
        status = "Live",
        team_1 = if(length(teams) >= 1) trimws(teams[1]) else NA_character_,
        team_2 = if(length(teams) >= 2) trimws(teams[2]) else NA_character_,
        team_1_prob = if(length(probs) >= 1) probs[1] else NA_character_,
        team_2_prob = if(length(probs) >= 2) probs[2] else NA_character_,
        game_date = NA_character_,
        sport = tryCatch({
          trimws(html_element(node, ".sport .sport-emoji") %>% html_attr("alt"))
        }, error = function(e) NA_character_)
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
}, error = function(e) {
  live_games <- data.frame()
})

# --- 2. Scrape "Inactive" Games (Starting Later & Finished) ---
tryCatch({
  response_inactive <- GET(url_inactive, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"))
  webpage_inactive <- read_html(response_inactive)
  
  # --- 2a. Parse "Starting Later" ---
  starting_later_nodes <- webpage_inactive %>% 
    html_elements("#later-container a.event-link")
  
  starting_later_games <- starting_later_nodes %>%
    lapply(function(node) {
      data.frame(
        status = "Starting Later",
        team_1 = trimws(html_element(node, ".team .away") %>% html_text()),
        team_2 = trimws(html_element(node, ".team .home") %>% html_text()),
        team_1_prob = trimws(html_element(node, ".prob .away") %>% html_text()),
        team_2_prob = trimws(html_element(node, ".prob .home") %>% html_text()),
        game_date = trimws(html_element(node, ".event-time .gt-timestamp") %>% html_text()),
        sport = trimws(html_element(node, ".sport .sport-emoji") %>% html_attr("alt"))
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  
  # --- 2b. Parse "Finished" ---
  finished_nodes <- webpage_inactive %>% 
    html_elements("#earlier-container a.event-link")
  
  finished_games <- finished_nodes %>%
    lapply(function(node) {
      team_1_is_winner <- !is.na(html_element(node, ".team .away.winner"))
      team_2_is_winner <- !is.na(html_element(node, ".team .home.winner"))
      
      data.frame(
        status = "Finished",
        team_1 = trimws(html_element(node, ".team .away") %>% html_text()),
        team_2 = trimws(html_element(node, ".team .home") %>% html_text()),
        team_1_prob = if_else(team_1_is_winner, "100%", if_else(team_2_is_winner, "0%", NA_character_)),
        team_2_prob = if_else(team_2_is_winner, "100%", if_else(team_1_is_winner, "0%", NA_character_)),
        game_date = trimws(html_element(node, ".event-time .gt-timestamp") %>% html_text()),
        sport = trimws(html_element(node, ".sport .sport-emoji") %>% html_attr("alt"))
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
}, error = function(e) {
  starting_later_games <- data.frame()
  finished_games <- data.frame()
})

# --- 3. Combine all data ---
all_games <- bind_rows(live_games, starting_later_games, finished_games)

# --- 4. Define "today" ---
m <- sub("^0", "", format(skins_date, "%m"))  # FIXED: Use skins_date instead of Sys.Date()
d <- sub("^0", "", format(skins_date, "%d"))  # FIXED: Use skins_date instead of Sys.Date()
today_date <- paste(m, d, sep="/")


# --- 5. Filter for NBA and Today ---
# CRITICAL FIX: Only include finished games if they have today's date
nba_today <- all_games %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sport),
    sport == "NBA",
    (status == "Live" | 
     (status == "Starting Later" & game_date == today_date) |
     (status == "Finished" & game_date == today_date))  # FIXED: Only include finished games from today
  )


# --- 6. Process and Join Scraped Data ---
if (nrow(nba_today) > 0 && nrow(todays_picks) > 0) {
  # Convert probabilities from "XX%" string to numeric (vectorized)
  convert_prob_to_num <- function(prob_str) {
    # Handle vector input
    num_val <- as.numeric(str_remove(prob_str, "%")) / 100.0
    # Return NA for invalid probabilities, otherwise return the numeric value
    ifelse(is.na(num_val) | num_val < 0 | num_val > 1, NA_real_, num_val)
  }
  
  # Process each game as a pair to maintain complementary probabilities
  nba_today_with_ids <- nba_today %>%
    mutate(
      game_pair_id = row_number(),
      prob_1_num = convert_prob_to_num(team_1_prob),
      prob_2_num = convert_prob_to_num(team_2_prob)
    )
  
  # Validate and normalize probabilities for each game
  nba_today_normalized <- nba_today_with_ids %>%
    mutate(
      prob_sum = prob_1_num + prob_2_num,
      # Only normalize if both probabilities exist and sum is reasonable (0.8 to 1.2)
      needs_normalization = !is.na(prob_1_num) & !is.na(prob_2_num) & 
                            prob_sum > 0.8 & prob_sum < 1.2 & 
                            abs(prob_sum - 1.0) > 0.02,
      prob_1_normalized = case_when(
        is.na(prob_1_num) ~ NA_real_,
        needs_normalization ~ prob_1_num / prob_sum,
        TRUE ~ prob_1_num
      ),
      prob_2_normalized = case_when(
        is.na(prob_2_num) ~ NA_real_,
        needs_normalization ~ prob_2_num / prob_sum,
        TRUE ~ prob_2_num
      )
    )
  
  # ADDITIONAL VALIDATION: Remove finished games with 100%/0% for upcoming games
  nba_today_validated <- nba_today_normalized %>%
    mutate(
      # Flag suspicious finished game data - if status is "Finished" but game_date is today
      # and the game hasn't actually finished according to plaintextsports
      is_suspicious = (status == "Finished" & 
                      game_date == today_date &
                      ((prob_1_normalized == 1 & prob_2_normalized == 0) |
                       (prob_1_normalized == 0 & prob_2_normalized == 1)))
    )
  
  # Create one row per team with standardized names
  live_data_team1 <- nba_today_validated %>%
    select(Team = team_1, live_win_prob = prob_1_normalized, game_pair_id, status, is_suspicious)
  
  live_data_team2 <- nba_today_validated %>%
    select(Team = team_2, live_win_prob = prob_2_normalized, game_pair_id, status, is_suspicious)
  
  live_data_combined <- bind_rows(live_data_team1, live_data_team2) %>%
    mutate(Team = trimws(Team)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Team), Team != "")
  
  # Standardize team names
  standardize_team_name <- function(team_name) {
    team_upper <- str_to_upper(team_name)
    
    # Check against all teams in draft_data
    for (i in 1:nrow(draft_data)) {
      keys <- str_split(draft_data$Matchup_Key[i], "\\|")[[1]]
      for (key in keys) {
        key_upper <- str_to_upper(key)
        # Use word boundaries for matching
        pattern <- paste0("\\b", key_upper, "\\b")
        if (str_detect(team_upper, regex(pattern))) {
          return(draft_data$Team[i])
        }
      }
      
      # Also try matching against the full team name
      if (str_detect(team_upper, str_to_upper(draft_data$Team[i]))) {
        return(draft_data$Team[i])
      }
      
      # Try matching against abbreviation
      if (team_upper == draft_data$abbr[i]) {
        return(draft_data$Team[i])
      }
    }
    
    # If no match found, return original
    return(team_name)
  }
  
  live_data_standardized <- live_data_combined %>%
    mutate(
      Team_Original = Team,
      Team = sapply(Team, standardize_team_name)
    )
  
  # For each standardized team, keep the most reliable probability
  # Prioritize: Live > Starting Later > (Don't use suspicious Finished)
  live_data_final <- live_data_standardized %>%
    mutate(
      status_priority = case_when(
        status == "Live" ~ 1,
        status == "Starting Later" ~ 2,
        status == "Finished" & is_suspicious == FALSE ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ 999  # Exclude suspicious finished games
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(status_priority < 999) %>%  # Exclude suspicious data
    arrange(Team, status_priority) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    filter(!is.na(live_win_prob)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Team, live_win_prob, status)
  
  
  # Join with todays_picks
  todays_picks <- todays_picks %>%
    left_join(live_data_final, by = "Team") %>%
    mutate(
      Live_Expected_Skins = case_when(
        is.na(live_win_prob) ~ `Expected Skins`,  # Default to Expected Skins if no live data
        Pick == "W" ~ live_win_prob,
        Pick == "L" ~ 1 - live_win_prob,
        TRUE ~ `Expected Skins`
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-live_win_prob, -status)
  
  # ADDITIONAL FIX: For teams in the same game, ensure consistent probabilities
  # This helps when one team's probability was scraped but the other wasn't
  todays_picks <- todays_picks %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      n_teams_in_game = n(),
      n_with_live_data = sum(Live_Expected_Skins != `Expected Skins`),
      # If only one team has live data but there are 2 teams, copy to the other
      should_share = n_teams_in_game == 2 & n_with_live_data == 1
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Live_Expected_Skins = if_else(
        should_share & Live_Expected_Skins == `Expected Skins`,
        first(Live_Expected_Skins[Live_Expected_Skins != `Expected Skins`]),
        Live_Expected_Skins
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-n_teams_in_game, -n_with_live_data, -should_share)
}

# Ensure Live_Expected_Skins column exists even if scraping was skipped
if (!"Live_Expected_Skins" %in% names(todays_picks)) {
  todays_picks <- todays_picks %>%
    mutate(Live_Expected_Skins = `Expected Skins`)
}
```

```{r results_and_luck}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Only process results if we have games today
if (nrow(todays_picks) > 0) {
  
  # Always scrape plaintextsports regardless of blackout window
  # 1. Scrape plaintextsports.com for live game data
  url_scores <- "https://plaintextsports.com/nba/"
  page_scores <- read_html(url_scores)
  
  # Get all text from the body
  all_text <- page_scores %>%
    html_element("body") %>%
    html_text2()
  
  # 2. Extract Game Blocks - Split into lines and get score boxes
  all_lines <- strsplit(all_text, "\n")[[1]]
  score_boxes <- all_lines[grepl("^\\+", all_lines)]
  
  # 3. Parse a single game box
  parse_game_box <- function(box) {
    # Split by "|" character
    parts <- strsplit(box, "\\|")[[1]]
    
    # Extract status, teams, and scores
    status <- str_trim(parts[2])
    
    # Team 1
    team1_line <- str_trim(parts[4])
    team1_name <- str_extract(team1_line, "[A-Z]{2,3}")
    team1_score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(team1_line, "[0-9]+$")))
    
    # Team 2
    team2_line <- str_trim(parts[6])
    team2_name <- str_extract(team2_line, "[A-Z]{2,3}")
    team2_score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(team2_line, "[0-9]+$")))
    
    # Determine if final
    is_final <- grepl("Final", status, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Determine if game is in progress
    is_in_progress <- grepl("Q[1-4]|Half|OT|\\d+:\\d+", status) & !is_final
    
    # Return data frame
    data.frame(
      Team1 = team1_name,
      Team2 = team2_name,
      Score1 = team1_score,
      Score2 = team2_score,
      Status = status,
      Finished = is_final,
      InProgress = is_in_progress,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # 4. Parse all game boxes
  if (length(score_boxes) > 0) {
    all_game_results <- bind_rows(lapply(score_boxes, parse_game_box))
  } else {
    all_game_results <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # 5. Standardize team abbreviations to match draft_data
  team_replacements <- c(
    "^GS$" = "GSW",
    "^NO$" = "NOP",
    "^NY$" = "NYK",
    "^SA$" = "SAS",
    "^WSH$" = "WAS"
  )
  
  # Apply standardization
  if (nrow(all_game_results) > 0) {
    all_game_results <- all_game_results %>%
      mutate(
        Team1 = str_replace_all(Team1, team_replacements),
        Team2 = str_replace_all(Team2, team_replacements)
      )
  }
  
  # 6. Create Won_Game lookup - only for finished games
  final_team_results <- data.frame(Abbr = character(), Won_Game = logical(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(all_game_results) > 0) {
    finished_games <- all_game_results %>% filter(Finished == TRUE)
    
    if (nrow(finished_games) > 0) {
      # Team 1 results
      team1_results <- finished_games %>%
        select(Abbr = Team1, PTS = Score1, Opp_PTS = Score2) %>%
        mutate(Won_Game = PTS > Opp_PTS)
      
      # Team 2 results
      team2_results <- finished_games %>%
        select(Abbr = Team2, PTS = Score2, Opp_PTS = Score1) %>%
        mutate(Won_Game = PTS > Opp_PTS)
      
      final_team_results <- bind_rows(team1_results, team2_results) %>%
        select(Abbr, Won_Game)
    }
  }
  
  # 6. Create todays_results with actual outcomes
  todays_results <- todays_picks %>%
    left_join(final_team_results, by = "Abbr", suffix = c("", "_new")) %>%
    mutate(
      Won_Game = coalesce(Won_Game_new, Won_Game),
      Actual_Skins = case_when(
        Won_Game == TRUE & Pick == "W" ~ 1,
        Won_Game == FALSE & Pick == "L" ~ 1,
        is.na(Won_Game) ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      Skins_Luck = Actual_Skins - `Expected Skins`
    ) %>%
    select(-Won_Game_new)
  
  # 7. Create score lookup for finished games
  finished_score_lookup <- data.frame(Abbr = character(), Final_Score = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(all_game_results) > 0) {
    finished_only <- all_game_results %>% filter(Finished == TRUE & !is.na(Score1) & !is.na(Score2))
    if (nrow(finished_only) > 0) {
      team1_scores <- finished_only %>%
        mutate(Final_Score = paste0(Score1, "-", Score2)) %>%
        select(Abbr = Team1, Final_Score)
      team2_scores <- finished_only %>%
        mutate(Final_Score = paste0(Score2, "-", Score1)) %>%
        select(Abbr = Team2, Final_Score)
      finished_score_lookup <- bind_rows(team1_scores, team2_scores)
    }
  }
  
  todays_results <- todays_results %>%
    left_join(finished_score_lookup, by = "Abbr") %>%
    mutate(Final_Score = if_else(is.na(Final_Score), "", Final_Score))
  
  # 8. Save today's results to file (use underscores for easier CSV handling)
  # This now correctly uses today_ct (which is skins_date) as the filename
  today_file <- file.path(history_dir, paste0(today_ct, ".csv"))
  
  todays_results %>%
    select(
      Date, Player, Team, Abbr, Pick, 
      Expected_Skins = `Expected Skins`, 
      Won_Game, Actual_Skins, Skins_Luck,
      game_id, Final_Score
    ) %>%
    write_csv(today_file)
} else {
  todays_results <- data.frame()
}
```

```{r card_helpers}
#| echo: false
# HTML builders for the scoreboard cards and compact tables
html_esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
fmt_pct <- function(p) if_else(is.na(p), "", paste0(round(p * 100), "%"))
luck_pill <- function(x) {
  cls <- case_when(x > 0.1 ~ " pos", x < -0.1 ~ " neg", TRUE ~ "")
  txt <- sprintf("%.1f", x)
  txt <- if_else(txt == "-0.0", "0.0", txt)
  txt <- if_else(x > 0.05, paste0("+", txt), txt)
  paste0("<span class='sk-pill", cls, "'>", txt, "</span>")
}

# Convert "7:00 PM ET"-style statuses to Central time; leave others as-is
to_ct <- function(s) {
  out <- s
  has_time <- !is.na(s) & str_detect(s, "\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}\\s*[AP]M\\s+ET")
  if (any(has_time)) {
    et <- parse_date_time(paste(Sys.Date(), str_extract(s[has_time], "\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}\\s*[AP]M")),
                          orders = "ymd I:M p", tz = "America/New_York")
    out[has_time] <- paste(sub("^0", "", format(with_tz(et, "America/Chicago"), "%I:%M %p")), "CT")
  }
  out
}

# Change vs pregame for a live chance, in percentage points ("▲19" / "▼19")
fmt_delta <- function(now, pre) {
  d <- round((now - pre) * 100)
  if (is.na(d) || abs(d) < 1) return("")
  paste0("<span class='delta ", if (d > 0) "up'>&#9650;" else "down'>&#9660;", abs(d), "</span>")
}
# Luck on a finished game: skin won (1/0) minus pregame chance
fmt_luck <- function(won, pre) {
  if (is.na(won) || is.na(pre)) return("")
  l <- as.numeric(won) - pre
  paste0("<span class='delta ", if (l >= 0) "up'>+" else "down'>&minus;", sprintf("%.2f", abs(l)), "</span>")
}

# Shaded band between the pregame tick and the current value, plus the tick itself
swing_marks <- function(now, pre, cls) {
  lo <- min(now, pre); hi <- max(now, pre)
  sprintf("<span class='gap %s' style='left:%.1f%%;width:%.1f%%'></span><span class='tick' title='Pregame %.0f%%' style='left:%.1f%%'></span>",
          cls, lo, hi - lo, pre, pre)
}

# Per-team bar (non zero-sum games): fill = current chance, tick = pregame
side_bar <- function(chance, pre) {
  now <- if (is.na(chance)) 0 else chance * 100
  p <- if (is.na(pre)) now else pre * 100
  paste0("<div class='barrow'><span class='fill' style='width:", sprintf("%.1f", now), "%'></span>",
         swing_marks(now, p, if (now >= p) "gain" else "loss"), "</div>")
}

# Zero-sum tug-of-war: first team's share from the left, second team's from the right
tug_bar <- function(g) {
  a <- if (is.na(g$Chance[1])) 50 else g$Chance[1] * 100
  p <- if (is.na(g$Expected[1])) a else g$Expected[1] * 100
  seg <- function(i, w) {
    cls <- paste0("seg", if (isTRUE(g$Won_Skin[i])) " won" else "")
    sprintf("<span class='%s' data-player='%s' style='width:%.1f%%'></span>", cls, html_esc(g$Player[i]), w)
  }
  paste0("<div class='tug'>", seg(1, a), seg(2, 100 - a), swing_marks(a, p, "swing"), "</div>")
}

# One team row inside a card. `won` is TRUE/FALSE once the game is final, else NA.
card_side <- function(abbr, player, pick, score, chance, pre, won, state, bar = TRUE) {
  cls <- paste0("side", if (isTRUE(won)) " won" else if (identical(won, FALSE)) " lost" else "")
  pct_txt <- if (state == "final") (if (isTRUE(won)) "&#10003;" else "") else fmt_pct(chance)
  change <- switch(state, final = fmt_luck(won, pre), live = fmt_delta(chance, pre), "")
  pick_word <- if (identical(pick, "L")) "lose" else "win"
  paste0(
    "<div class='", cls, "' data-player='", html_esc(player), "'>",
    "<div class='abbr'>", html_esc(abbr), "</div>",
    "<div class='owner'><span class='name'>", html_esc(player), "</span>",
    "<span class='pick' title='Picked to ", pick_word, "'>", html_esc(pick), "</span></div>",
    "<div class='score'>", if (is.na(score)) "" else score, "</div>",
    "<div class='pct'>", pct_txt, "</div>",
    "<div class='chg'>", change, "</div>",
    if (bar) paste0("<div></div>", side_bar(chance, pre)) else "",
    "</div>"
  )
}

# ESPN game page for each team playing on `date` (named by our abbreviations); empty if ESPN is unreachable
espn_links <- function(date) {
  tryCatch({
    sb <- jsonlite::fromJSON(paste0("https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/scoreboard?dates=",
                                    format(date, "%Y%m%d")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
    fix <- c(GS = "GSW", NY = "NYK", SA = "SAS", NO = "NOP", UTAH = "UTA", WSH = "WAS")
    out <- character()
    for (ev in sb$events) {
      for (cmp in ev$competitions[[1]]$competitors) {
        ab <- cmp$team$abbreviation
        out[if (ab %in% names(fix)) fix[[ab]] else ab] <- paste0("https://www.espn.com/nba/game/_/gameId/", ev$id)
      }
    }
    out
  }, error = function(e) character())
}

# df: one row per drafted team with game_id, Player, Abbr, Pick, Expected (pregame skin chance),
# Chance (live skin chance), Won_Skin, Own_Score, State (upcoming/live/final), Status_Text, sort_key
# links: from espn_links(); cards fall back to that day's ESPN scoreboard
build_cards <- function(df, container_id, links = character(), date = Sys.Date()) {
  games <- split(df, df$game_id)
  games <- games[order(vapply(games, function(g) g$sort_key[1], numeric(1)))]
  cards <- vapply(games, function(g) {
    state <- g$State[1]
    # Zero-sum: both owners need the same result (W/W or L/L), so exactly one skin is available
    zero_sum <- nrow(g) == 2 && identical(g$Pick[1], g$Pick[2])
    upset <- state == "final" && any(g$Won_Skin %in% TRUE & g$Expected < 0.5)
    sides <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) {
      card_side(g$Abbr[i], g$Player[i], g$Pick[i], g$Own_Score[i], g$Chance[i], g$Expected[i],
                g$Won_Skin[i], state, bar = !zero_sum)
    }, character(1))
    badges <- paste0(
      if (zero_sum) "<span class='badge zs'>1 SKIN &middot; ZERO-SUM</span>" else "",
      if (upset) "<span class='badge upset'>UPSET</span>" else ""
    )
    label <- switch(state, final = "Skin", live = "Live skin chance", "Skin chance")
    foot <- if (state == "upcoming") {
      paste0("Expected skins: ", paste0(html_esc(g$Player), " ", sprintf("%.2f", g$Expected), collapse = " &middot; "))
    } else {
      paste0("Pregame: ", paste0(html_esc(g$Abbr), " ", fmt_pct(g$Expected), collapse = " / "))
    }
    href <- unname(c(links[intersect(g$Abbr, names(links))], paste0("https://www.espn.com/nba/scoreboard/_/date/", format(date, "%Y%m%d")))[1])
    paste0(
      "<article class='sk-card' data-state='", state, "' data-players='", html_esc(paste(unique(g$Player), collapse = " ")), "'>",
      "<a class='sk-stretch' href='", href, "' target='_blank' rel='noopener' aria-label='Open ", html_esc(paste(g$Abbr, collapse = " vs ")), " on ESPN'></a>",
      "<div class='top'><span class='status'><span class='", state, "'>", html_esc(g$Status_Text[1]), "</span>", badges, "</span>",
      "<span>", label, "</span></div>",
      paste(sides, collapse = ""),
      if (zero_sum) tug_bar(g) else "",
      "<div class='foot'>", foot, "</div>",
      "</article>"
    )
  }, character(1))
  paste0("<div class='sk-games' id='", container_id, "'>", paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), "</div>")
}

# Compact per-player table. rows: Player plus the named numeric columns in `cols` (header = name).
build_table <- function(rows, cols, table_id, data_attrs = FALSE) {
  head <- paste0("<thead><tr><th>Player</th>", paste0("<th>", names(cols), "</th>", collapse = ""), "</tr></thead>")
  body <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
    r <- rows[i, ]
    cells <- vapply(cols, function(f) f(r), character(1))
    attrs <- if (data_attrs) {
      sprintf(" data-games='%d' data-exp='%.1f' data-live='%.1f' data-won='%d' data-luck='%.1f'",
              as.integer(r$Games), r$Expected, r$Live, as.integer(r$Won), r$Luck)
    } else ""
    paste0("<tr data-player='", html_esc(r$Player), "'", attrs, "><td>", html_esc(r$Player), "</td>",
           paste0("<td>", cells, "</td>", collapse = ""), "</tr>")
  }, character(1))
  paste0("<div class='sk-tablewrap'><table class='sk-table' id='", table_id, "' data-quarto-disable-processing='true'>",
         head, "<tbody>", paste(body, collapse = ""), "</tbody></table></div>")
}

cat_html <- function(x) cat("\n```{=html}\n", x, "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r me_picker}
#| echo: false
```

```{r today_summary}
# Today by player: Live counts a finished game as its actual skin, otherwise the live skin chance
if (exists("todays_results") && nrow(todays_results) > 0) {
  day_summary <- todays_results %>%
    mutate(Live_Now = if_else(!is.na(Won_Game), Actual_Skins, coalesce(Live_Expected_Skins, `Expected Skins`))) %>%
    group_by(Player) %>%
    summarise(
      Games = n(),
      Expected = sum(`Expected Skins`, na.rm = TRUE),
      Live = sum(Live_Now, na.rm = TRUE),
      Won = sum(Actual_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Luck = Live - Expected) %>%
    arrange(desc(Luck))

  cat_html(paste0(
    "<details class='sk-fold' id='fold-today' open><summary>Today by player</summary><div class='sk-inner'>",
    build_table(day_summary, list(
      G = function(r) as.character(r$Games),
      Exp = function(r) sprintf("%.1f", r$Expected),
      Live = function(r) sprintf("%.1f", r$Live),
      `Live %` = function(r) paste0(round(100 * r$Live / r$Games), "%"),
      Won = function(r) as.character(r$Won),
      Luck = function(r) luck_pill(r$Luck)
    ), "sk-today-summary", data_attrs = TRUE),
    "<p class='sk-note'>Live % = live expected skins per game. Luck = live expected skins minus pregame expected skins.</p>",
    "</div></details>"
  ))
}
```

```{r todays_games}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: 'asis'

cat_html("<h2 class='sk-h'>Games</h2>")
# Create Head-to-Head Matchup Table
if (nrow(todays_picks) > 0) {
  
  # Scrape plaintextsports.com for game results
  url_scores <- "https://plaintextsports.com/nba/"
  page_scores <- read_html(url_scores)
  
  # Get all text
  all_text <- page_scores %>%
    html_element("body") %>%
    html_text2()
  
  # Extract score boxes
  all_lines <- strsplit(all_text, "\n")[[1]]
  score_boxes <- all_lines[grepl("^\\+", all_lines)]
  
  # Parse game boxes
  parse_game_box <- function(box) {
    parts <- strsplit(box, "\\|")[[1]]
    status <- str_trim(parts[2])
    
    team1_line <- str_trim(parts[4])
    team1_name <- str_extract(team1_line, "[A-Z]{2,3}")
    team1_score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(team1_line, "[0-9]+$")))
    
    team2_line <- str_trim(parts[6])
    team2_name <- str_extract(team2_line, "[A-Z]{2,3}")
    team2_score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(team2_line, "[0-9]+$")))
    
    is_final <- grepl("Final", status, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Determine if game is in progress: contains Q1-Q4, Half, OT, or time with a colon
    is_in_progress <- grepl("Q[1-4]|Half|OT|\\d+:\\d+", status) & !is_final
    
    data.frame(
      Team1 = team1_name,
      Team2 = team2_name,
      Score1 = team1_score,
      Score2 = team2_score,
      Status = status,
      Finished = is_final,
      InProgress = is_in_progress,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Parse all games
  if (length(score_boxes) > 0) {
    matchup_game_results <- bind_rows(lapply(score_boxes, parse_game_box))
  } else {
    matchup_game_results <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # Standardize abbreviations: Map scraped names to draft_data names
  team_replacements <- c(
    "^GS$" = "GSW",
    "^NO$" = "NOP",
    "^NY$" = "NYK",
    "^SA$" = "SAS",
    "^WSH$" = "WAS"
  )
  
  if (nrow(matchup_game_results) > 0) {
    matchup_game_results <- matchup_game_results %>%
      mutate(
        Team1 = str_replace_all(Team1, team_replacements),
        Team2 = str_replace_all(Team2, team_replacements)
      )
  }
  
  # Create Won_Game lookup - only final games
  matchup_won_lookup <- data.frame(Abbr = character(), Won_Game = logical(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  matchup_status_lookup <- data.frame(Abbr = character(), GameStatus = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # FIXED: Create score lookup ONLY for games that are in progress or finished
  matchup_score_lookup <- data.frame(Abbr = character(), Score = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(matchup_game_results) > 0) {
    # Won_Game lookup for finished games
    finished_games <- matchup_game_results %>% filter(Finished == TRUE)
    
    if (nrow(finished_games) > 0) {
      team_1 <- finished_games %>%
        select(Abbr = Team1, PTS = Score1, Opp_PTS = Score2) %>%
        mutate(Won_Game = PTS > Opp_PTS)
      
      team_2 <- finished_games %>%
        select(Abbr = Team2, PTS = Score2, Opp_PTS = Score1) %>%
        mutate(Won_Game = PTS > Opp_PTS)
      
      matchup_won_lookup <- bind_rows(team_1, team_2) %>%
        select(Abbr, Won_Game)
    }
    
    # Status lookup for all games
    all_games_status <- matchup_game_results %>%
      mutate(
        GameStatus = case_when(
          Finished == TRUE ~ "Final",
          InProgress == TRUE ~ str_remove(Status, "^(WA|WB|WC|WD|EA|EB|EC|ED)\\s+"),
          TRUE ~ Status  # Keep original Status for upcoming games (contains game time)
        )
      )
    
    team_1_status <- all_games_status %>%
      select(Abbr = Team1, GameStatus)
    
    team_2_status <- all_games_status %>%
      select(Abbr = Team2, GameStatus)
    
    matchup_status_lookup <- bind_rows(team_1_status, team_2_status) %>%
      distinct()
    
    # FIXED: Score lookup ONLY for games that are in progress or finished
    games_with_scores <- matchup_game_results %>%
      filter((InProgress == TRUE | Finished == TRUE) & !is.na(Score1) & !is.na(Score2))
    
    if (nrow(games_with_scores) > 0) {
      team_1_scores <- games_with_scores %>%
        mutate(Score = paste0(Score1, "-", Score2)) %>%
        select(Abbr = Team1, Score)
      
      team_2_scores <- games_with_scores %>%
        mutate(Score = paste0(Score2, "-", Score1)) %>%
        select(Abbr = Team2, Score)
      
      matchup_score_lookup <- bind_rows(team_1_scores, team_2_scores) %>%
        distinct()
    }
  }
  
  # Update todays_picks with Won_Game, GameStatus, and Score
  todays_picks <- todays_picks %>%
    left_join(matchup_won_lookup, by = "Abbr", suffix = c("", "_new")) %>%
    left_join(matchup_status_lookup, by = "Abbr") %>%
    left_join(matchup_score_lookup, by = "Abbr") %>%
    mutate(
      Won_Game = coalesce(Won_Game_new, Won_Game),
      Won_Skin = case_when(
        Won_Game == TRUE & Pick == "W" ~ TRUE,
        Won_Game == FALSE & Pick == "L" ~ TRUE,
        is.na(Won_Game) ~ NA,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      Game_Status = GameStatus,
      Game_Score = if_else(is.na(Score), "", Score)
    ) %>%
    select(-Won_Game_new, -GameStatus, -Score)
  
  # --- Scoreboard cards: one per game, live first, then upcoming by tip-off, then finals ---
  card_data <- todays_picks %>%
    mutate(
      Status_CT = to_ct(Game_Status),
      State = case_when(
        Game_Status == "Final" ~ "final",
        is.na(Game_Status) | str_detect(Status_CT, "CT$") ~ "upcoming",
        TRUE ~ "live"
      ),
      Status_Text = case_when(
        !is.na(Status_CT) ~ Status_CT,
        !is.na(game_time_ct) ~ paste(sub("^0", "", format(game_time_ct, "%I:%M %p", tz = "America/Chicago")), "CT"),
        TRUE ~ "Today"
      ),
      Expected = `Expected Skins`,
      Chance = case_when(
        !is.na(Won_Skin) ~ as.numeric(Won_Skin),
        !is.na(Live_Expected_Skins) ~ Live_Expected_Skins,
        TRUE ~ `Expected Skins`
      ),
      Own_Score = if_else(State == "upcoming", NA_character_, str_extract(Game_Score, "^\\d+")),
      live_order = case_when(
        str_detect(Status_CT, "OT|Q4") ~ 1,
        str_detect(Status_CT, "Q3") ~ 2,
        str_detect(Status_CT, "Half") ~ 3,
        str_detect(Status_CT, "Q2") ~ 4,
        TRUE ~ 5
      ),
      sort_key = case_when(
        State == "live" ~ live_order,
        State == "upcoming" ~ 10 + coalesce(as.numeric(game_time_ct) / 1e10, 0.9),
        TRUE ~ 20
      )
    )

  cat_html(build_cards(card_data, "sk-today-games", espn_links(today_ct), today_ct))
} else {
  cat("No games scheduled for today.")
}
```

```{r yesterday_matchup_table}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: 'asis'

# FIXED: Scrape actual matchups from date-specific URL, then join with CSV data
yesterday_ct <- today_ct - days(1)
yesterday_file <- file.path(history_dir, paste0(yesterday_ct, ".csv"))

if (file.exists(yesterday_file)) {
  yesterday_data <- read_csv(yesterday_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(yesterday_data) > 0) {
    
    # Scrape yesterday's actual matchups from date-specific URL
    yesterday_url <- paste0("https://plaintextsports.com/nba/", yesterday_ct, "/")
    yesterday_page <- read_html(yesterday_url)
    yesterday_text <- yesterday_page %>% html_element("body") %>% html_text2()
    yesterday_lines <- strsplit(yesterday_text, "\n")[[1]]
    yesterday_boxes <- yesterday_lines[grepl("^\\+", yesterday_lines)]
    
    # Parse game boxes to get actual matchups and scores
    parse_game_box <- function(box) {
      parts <- strsplit(box, "\\|")[[1]]
      status <- str_trim(parts[2])
      team1_line <- str_trim(parts[4])
      team1_name <- str_extract(team1_line, "[A-Z]{2,3}")
      team1_score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(team1_line, "[0-9]+$")))
      team2_line <- str_trim(parts[6])
      team2_name <- str_extract(team2_line, "[A-Z]{2,3}")
      team2_score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(team2_line, "[0-9]+$")))
      is_final <- grepl("Final", status, fixed = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        Team1 = team1_name,
        Team2 = team2_name,
        Score1 = team1_score,
        Score2 = team2_score,
        Status = status,
        Finished = is_final,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    # Get all matchups
    if (length(yesterday_boxes) > 0) {
      yesterday_matchups <- bind_rows(lapply(yesterday_boxes, parse_game_box))
      
      # Standardize team abbreviations
      team_replacements <- c(
        "^GS$" = "GSW", "^NO$" = "NOP", "^NY$" = "NYK",
        "^SA$" = "SAS", "^WSH$" = "WAS"
      )
      
      yesterday_matchups <- yesterday_matchups %>%
        mutate(
          Team1 = str_replace_all(Team1, team_replacements),
          Team2 = str_replace_all(Team2, team_replacements),
          scrape_game_id = paste0("game_", row_number())
        )
      
      # Create score lookup for finished games
      yesterday_score_lookup <- data.frame(Abbr = character(), Scraped_Score = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      finished_yesterday <- yesterday_matchups %>% filter(Finished == TRUE & !is.na(Score1) & !is.na(Score2))
      if (nrow(finished_yesterday) > 0) {
        score_team1 <- finished_yesterday %>%
          mutate(Scraped_Score = paste0(Score1, "-", Score2)) %>%
          select(Abbr = Team1, Scraped_Score)
        score_team2 <- finished_yesterday %>%
          mutate(Scraped_Score = paste0(Score2, "-", Score1)) %>%
          select(Abbr = Team2, Scraped_Score)
        yesterday_score_lookup <- bind_rows(score_team1, score_team2)
      }
      
      # Create lookup: each team to its game_id
      team_to_game <- bind_rows(
        yesterday_matchups %>% select(Abbr = Team1, scrape_game_id),
        yesterday_matchups %>% select(Abbr = Team2, scrape_game_id)
      )
      
      # Join CSV data with game_id from actual matchups
      # Safely add Final_Score column if it doesn't exist in the CSV
      if (!"Final_Score" %in% names(yesterday_data)) {
        yesterday_data <- yesterday_data %>% mutate(Final_Score = NA_character_)
      }
      
      yesterday_with_game <- yesterday_data %>%
        left_join(team_to_game, by = "Abbr") %>%
        left_join(yesterday_score_lookup, by = "Abbr") %>%
        mutate(
          # Use scraped score if available, otherwise fall back to stored Final_Score column
          Final_Score_Display = case_when(
            !is.na(Scraped_Score) & Scraped_Score != "" ~ Scraped_Score,
            !is.na(Final_Score) & Final_Score != "" ~ as.character(Final_Score),
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          Won_Skin = case_when(
            is.na(Won_Game) ~ NA,
            Pick == "W" & Won_Game == TRUE ~ TRUE,
            Pick == "L" & Won_Game == FALSE ~ TRUE,
            TRUE ~ FALSE
          ),
          Game_Status = ifelse(is.na(Won_Game), "Not Started", "Final")
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(scrape_game_id))
      
      if (nrow(yesterday_with_game) > 0) {
        yesterday_cards <- yesterday_with_game %>%
          mutate(
            game_id = scrape_game_id,
            State = if_else(is.na(Won_Game), "upcoming", "final"),
            Status_Text = if_else(is.na(Won_Game), "No result", "Final"),
            Expected = Expected_Skins,
            Chance = if_else(is.na(Won_Skin), Expected_Skins, as.numeric(Won_Skin)),
            Own_Score = str_extract(Final_Score_Display, "^\\d+"),
            sort_key = 0
          )

        yesterday_summary <- yesterday_with_game %>%
          group_by(Player) %>%
          summarise(
            Games = n(),
            Expected = sum(Expected_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
            Won = sum(Actual_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
            Luck = sum(Skins_Luck, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          arrange(desc(Luck))

        cat_html(paste0(
          "<p class='sk-meta'>", format(yesterday_ct, "%A, %B %d"), "</p>",
          build_cards(yesterday_cards, "sk-yesterday-games", espn_links(yesterday_ct), yesterday_ct),
          "<h2 class='sk-h'>Yesterday by player</h2>",
          build_table(yesterday_summary, list(
            Games = function(r) as.character(r$Games),
            Expected = function(r) sprintf("%.1f", r$Expected),
            Won = function(r) as.character(r$Won),
            Luck = function(r) luck_pill(r$Luck)
          ), "sk-yesterday-summary")
        ))
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat(paste0("No data available for ", format(yesterday_ct, "%A, %B %d, %Y"), "."))
}
```

```{r ytd_setup}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Create/update historical baseline data
historical_file <- file.path(history_dir, "ytd_baseline.csv")

# New season: everyone starts at zero on opening night and every daily CSV from
# SEASON_START onward is added on top. (2025-26 daily files are archived in skins_history/archive/2025-26/)
ytd_baseline <- tibble(
  Player = PLAYERS,
  Games = 0,
  Total_Expected_Skins = 0,
  Total_Actual_Skins = 0,
  Cumulative_Skins_Luck = 0
)

# Save/overwrite the baseline file
write_csv(ytd_baseline, historical_file)

baseline_date_file <- file.path(history_dir, "baseline_date.txt")
writeLines(as.character(SEASON_START), baseline_date_file)
baseline_date <- SEASON_START
```

```{r ytd_cumulative}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: 'asis'

ytd_data <- data.frame()
all_files <- list.files(history_dir, pattern = "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(all_files) > 0) {
  valid_files <- all_files[sapply(all_files, function(f) {
    file_date <- as_date(str_extract(basename(f), "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}"))
    return(!is.na(file_date) && file_date >= baseline_date)
  })]

  if (length(valid_files) > 0) {
    all_history <- bind_rows(lapply(valid_files, function(f) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)))
    ytd_data <- all_history %>%
      filter(Date >= baseline_date, !is.na(Actual_Skins))
  }
}

# Baseline plus every finished game since SEASON_START
ytd_new_data <- if (nrow(ytd_data) > 0) {
  ytd_data %>%
    group_by(Player) %>%
    summarise(
      Games = n(),
      Total_Expected_Skins = sum(Expected_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
      Total_Actual_Skins = sum(Actual_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
      Cumulative_Skins_Luck = sum(Skins_Luck, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
} else {
  ytd_baseline[0, ]
}

ytd_summary <- bind_rows(ytd_baseline, ytd_new_data) %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  summarise(
    Games = sum(Games),
    Expected = sum(Total_Expected_Skins),
    Won = sum(Total_Actual_Skins),
    Luck = sum(Cumulative_Skins_Luck),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Luck))

cat_html(paste0(
  build_table(ytd_summary, list(
    Games = function(r) as.character(r$Games),
    Expected = function(r) sprintf("%.1f", r$Expected),
    Won = function(r) as.character(r$Won),
    Luck = function(r) luck_pill(r$Luck)
  ), "sk-season-summary"),
  "<p class='sk-note'>Finished games only. Luck = skins won minus expected skins.</p>"
))
```

```{r ytd_charts}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: 'asis'

# Always generate charts - use baseline + any new data
# Create baseline starting point for charts
baseline_chart_date <- baseline_date - days(1)
baseline_start <- ytd_baseline %>%
  mutate(
    Date = baseline_chart_date,
    Daily_Expected = Total_Expected_Skins,
    Daily_Actual = Total_Actual_Skins,
    Daily_Luck = Cumulative_Skins_Luck
  ) %>%
  select(Player, Date, Daily_Expected, Daily_Actual, Daily_Luck)

# Get new daily data if available
if (exists("ytd_data") && nrow(ytd_data) > 0) {
  daily_data_summarized <- ytd_data %>%
    group_by(Player, Date) %>%
    summarise(
      Daily_Expected = sum(Expected_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
      Daily_Actual = sum(Actual_Skins, na.rm = TRUE),
      Daily_Luck = sum(Skins_Luck, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Combine baseline with new data
  chart_data <- bind_rows(baseline_start, daily_data_summarized) %>%
    arrange(Player, Date) %>%
    group_by(Player) %>%
    mutate(
      Cumulative_Expected = cumsum(Daily_Expected),
      Cumulative_Actual = cumsum(Daily_Actual),
      Cumulative_Luck = cumsum(Daily_Luck)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
} else {
  # Just use baseline if no new data yet
  chart_data <- baseline_start %>%
    mutate(
      Cumulative_Expected = Daily_Expected,
      Cumulative_Actual = Daily_Actual,
      Cumulative_Luck = Daily_Luck
    )
}

# Interactive charts (drawn in the browser): one point per player per day, carried forward on days off
chart_long <- bind_rows(baseline_start, if (nrow(ytd_data) > 0) daily_data_summarized) %>%
  group_by(Player, Date) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Daily_Expected, Daily_Actual, Daily_Luck), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(Player = PLAYERS, Date, fill = list(Daily_Expected = 0, Daily_Actual = 0, Daily_Luck = 0)) %>%
  arrange(Player, Date) %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  mutate(luck = cumsum(Daily_Luck), exp = cumsum(Daily_Expected), won = cumsum(Daily_Actual)) %>%
  ungroup()

chart_dates <- sort(unique(chart_long$Date))
hist_json <- vapply(seq_along(chart_dates), function(i) {
  rows <- chart_long[chart_long$Date == chart_dates[i], ]
  paste0('{"d":"', format(chart_dates[i]), '","r":{',
         paste(sprintf('"%s":{"luck":%.3f,"exp":%.3f,"won":%d}', rows$Player, rows$luck, rows$exp, as.integer(rows$won)), collapse = ","),
         "}}")
}, character(1))
# Same player colors as the Standings page
player_colors <- c(Eristeo = "#3E97D6", Brian = "#E26A54", Adam = "#22A794")

cat_html(paste0(
  "<h2 class='sk-h'>Season charts</h2>",
  "<div class='sk-chart' id='sk-chart'><div class='sk-ctabs'><span class='sk-seg' id='sk-ctabs'>",
  "<button type='button' data-c='luck' aria-pressed='true'>Luck</button>",
  "<button type='button' data-c='exp'>Expected</button>",
  "<button type='button' data-c='won'>Won</button></span></div>",
  "<div class='sk-cttl' id='sk-cttl'></div><p class='sk-cdsc' id='sk-cdsc'></p>",
  "<div class='sk-cleg' id='sk-cleg'></div>",
  "<div class='sk-plot' id='sk-plot'><div class='sk-empty'>Charts need JavaScript.</div></div></div>",
  "<script type='application/json' id='sk-chart-data'>{\"players\":[",
  paste0('"', PLAYERS, '"', collapse = ","), "],\"colors\":{",
  paste0('"', names(player_colors), '":"', player_colors, '"', collapse = ","), "},\"hist\":[",
  paste(hist_json, collapse = ","), "]}</script>"
))
```
